name: Cash Connection- Grants Pass

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large single-story commercial building with a flat white roof showing areas of rust and wear|Multiple rooftop HVAC units are present|Paved parking areas surround the building on multiple sides and hold numerous vehicles|Adjacent smaller structures and outdoor storage or equipment are visible along one side|Street frontage runs along SW 6th St.

alpha.desc: The front of the building shows a single-story commercial storefront with visible signage|A street parking area is located in front and along the side of the building|A single vehicle is parked on the site|A large tree stands near the property|Street frontage and sidewalk are present along the main road.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the side of the flat-roofed commercial structure|Paved parking and outdoor storage or equipment areas extend along this side|Multiple vehicles and materials are present|Adjacent structures border the property|Street and alley access are visible.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the rear and full roof surface of the commercial structure|Paved parking and outdoor areas hold multiple vehicles and stored items|Adjacent buildings and open lots surround the site|Access lanes continue around the perimeter.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the side of the commercial structure|Signage is visible on the front facade|A paved parking lot holds multiple vehicles|Side access and adjacent buildings are present|Street frontage and circulation space run along the property edge.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from SW 6th St into paved parking areas on the front and sides of the building. Multiple vehicles occupy the parking spaces. The structure is a single-story commercial building with a flat roof and rooftop units. Outdoor storage and equipment are present along the left side of the property. Adjacent commercial buildings and open lots surround the site. The property is located in a mixed commercial area near other retail businesses and a public park.
